scripts.build: node -e 'fs.writeFileSync("./firebase-config.js", `export const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: "${process.env.FIREBASE_API_KEY}", authDomain: "${process.env.FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN}", projectId: "${process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID}", storageBucket: "${process.env.FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET}", messagingSenderId: "${process.env.FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID}", appId: "${process.env.FIREBASE_APP_ID}", measurementId: "${process.env.FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID}" };`)
